Reference exposure is represented by Coherent as a scaled InP and AI datacenter optics supplier. The underfollowed lane prioritizes upstream or sideways chokepoints: Veeco for InP laser manufacturing equipment, Aehr Test Systems for wafer-level burn-in/test tied to silicon photonics and optical I/O, and Aeluma as a speculative III-V-on-silicon alternative platform for photodetectors and photonics.
